summary: The filing reports Exyn Technologies' entry into an underwriting agreement for its IPO of 2,500,000 units at $7.75 per unit, each consisting of one common share and one warrant. The underwriters purchased units at $7.13 per unit. The warrants have a $9.69 exercise price and five-year term. While an IPO is a capital-raising event, it does not fit the special-situations categories as a strategic capital return, restructuring, or other listed event. This is an ordinary IPO registration and sale, not a special situation.
